evidence.title: DataBank reports current construction across its Red Oak first phase
evidence.excerpt: DataBank's dated report describes active work at its Red Oak campus and identifies DFW9–DFW12 as the first phase. It distinguishes the first building's expected August opening from the remaining phased delivery.
